newsitem.title: USA: U.S Northwest products turned mixed with Calif..
newsitem.headline: U.S Northwest products turned mixed with Calif..

text.p: U.S. Northwest spot product prices followed California markets by turning mixed, with distillates firmer and gasoline weak.
An absence of news and generally poor markets conditions kept buyers and sellers out of the market.
"The Merc's (New York Mercantile Exchange) been crazy. This time of year there is usually a bearish mood," one traders said, noting a decrease in farming and motorist demand.
Seattle regular unleaded gasoline eased 0.50 cent to 62.50/63.50 cents a gallon on Monday.
Jet fuel in Seattle was notionally one cent higher at 76.50/77.50 cents a gallon.
Low sulphur diesel gained a cent to 75/76 cents a gallon.
